name: vasi-vasi
description: வாசி வாசி — a free, fully offline, no-AI reading companion for blind and low-vision readers.

comments.zero-cost-guarantee: The shipped app has ZERO runtime dependencies and needs no npm install, no build step and no server code. npm is used only for the optional integration test suite (jsdom).
comments.reproducibility: Runtime behavior is fully defined by the static files in this repository; tests pin the only dev dependency via package-lock.json.
